meta.source: src/app/globals.css, src/app/layout.tsx and the Ch 1.2 screens of github.com/WilliM233/fluxnook at dev 2ac600f
meta.note: One theme today. Nebula and Dusk were drawn on the Ch 1.2 palette board and wait for the theme setting (Deferral); they land here as further themes, not as new token names.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Near-black violet; shadcn --background. Every signed-in page sits on it, and the sign-in page too.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the search input, the chip rail, the sheet's panel; shadcn --card, --popover, --muted, --secondary. One step up from ground, never a third step.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default border: card edges, the header and footer rules, section dividers; shadcn --border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: A border that has to read on its own: the Open button, the type pill, the no-poster dash, the search input, the sheet's edge; shadcn --input.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Titles and body; shadcn --foreground. 14.9:1 on ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: years, summaries, nav links at rest, the looks-like line; shadcn --muted-foreground. 7.4:1 on ground, 6.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Tertiary text at 13px and under: captions, counts, the footer line, placeholder text, the no-poster label. 4.6:1 on ground; keep it off surface below 14px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one lavender: primary button fill, links, 'In your catalog', the selected sheet edge, focus rings; shadcn --primary and --ring. Never a background behind body text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Links and the primary button on hover.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent: the primary button's label; shadcn --primary-foreground. 10.1:1 on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Zod field errors and the add-failed line under a row. shadcn's own value, kept; the only hue outside the violet range.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: The item page's title. text-5xl leading-none tracking-tight.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: A page's heading at 400, so it sits back from the rows below it.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The header's wordmark, lowercase, a link to /nook.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: A result row's or a recent row's title.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A heading inside a sheet or a card.

styles.name: link-title
styles.usage: A connected item or a shelf on the item page: a link in text, accent-hover on hover.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: The story of misfit high-school girl Carrie White.
styles.usage: The item page's summary, in muted, max-w-prose.

styles.name: input
styles.sample: Search films, TV and books, or type an ISBN
styles.usage: The search box's text and placeholder.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Facts, summaries in rows, button labels at 500, nav links at 500.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: A row's status line, the header's email, the footer, the sheet's fine print; in muted or dim.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Fact labels and source notes on the item page, in dim.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase: the type pill, the sheet's two column heads (TMDB side in accent, catalog side in dim). tracking-widest.

styles.name: label-wide
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels on the item page, in dim. tracking-wider.

styles.name: tiny
styles.usage: Only inside the no-poster box, in dim.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale as the screens use it. Named by the Tailwind step so a class and a token say the same thing.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Fact label to value.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip rail padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Row title to summary; chips in the rail.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pill rows, fact rows.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Title, year and pill on a baseline; sheet column gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stacks of rows; the sheet's thumb to its text; section heading to its list.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Row padding; sheet card padding; the result list's gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row thumb to text; page side gutter at phone width; input side padding.

tokens.name: space-4.5
tokens.usage: Button side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Nav link gap; sheet section gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Header item gap; item page side gutter; section top padding above a rule.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; item page fact grid column gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Item page section stack.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Header and footer side padding from sm up.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Item page outer padding and the gap between cover column and facts; the button's min height (min-h-11).

radius.note: --radius is 0.625rem; shadcn derives the scale from it. Pills and the type chip are full.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Not used on a screen yet; shadcn's smallest.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The cover thumb in a row or a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, the Open link, the chip rail's chips.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The search input, the chip rail, the sheet's two cards, the item page cover, the facts strip.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: A result row.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The type pill and the franchise pill.

tokens.name: cover
tokens.usage: The item page's cover only (shadow-2xl). Nothing else casts a shadow; edges are lines.
